topic: Elvis and James Brown — the mutual respect between the two Kings
script: In August 1977, James Brown picked up the phone with one request: let him inside Graceland. Elvis Presley was dead. Their friendship had begun eleven years earlier, at a Jackie Wilson show in a Hollywood nightclub. George Klein, Elvis's longtime friend, made the introduction. Klein recalled Elvis's words that night: "Take me to James." In the years that followed, Brown came to Graceland, sometimes unannounced, and the two men spent nights singing gospel songs together. Two Kings. One of rock and roll. One of soul. Brown later wrote, "I wasn't just a fan, I was his brother." At the private viewing, Klein remembered, Brown sat motionless in a corner of the living room for a long while. The next spring, he released "Love Me Tender." A song for the King, sung by his brother.
